cases.question:
Please draft a complete but compact exploratory experiment for twelve model agents sharing a public-goods fund. This is a digital behavior pilot, not a human-subject prediction and not a test of consciousness. Use the installed commons World, not renewable stock or a custom resource economy. Every agent starts each round with 12 credits; contributions are sealed until settlement and the multiplier is 2. The only experimental contrast is whether public messages are available. Keep communication enabled in both arms and retain reports and promises in both; remove only the messages channel in the control. Keep signal privacy, payoff rules, the credit schedule, all profiles and all inference settings identical.

Use exactly twelve agents, two conditions, six rounds, seeds 17, 83 and 241, and one repetition per seed. All participants use GPT-6 Luna with the same direct-action harness, low reasoning effort and a 4096-token response allowance. The whole experiment API ceiling is $1, not $1 per run and not a one-credit endowment. That ceiling does not authorize execution now. There are no external tools, documents or code execution. Keep profile goals identical in substantive meaning: pursue personal credits while considering the shared fund, without instructing anyone to cooperate, defect, lie or send messages.

Operationalize contribution rate using actual contributed amounts relative to available credits, and summarize group payoff from settled values. Describe message use separately from the randomized availability contrast. Retain zero contributions, empty messages, null differences and unfavorable outcomes. Retain interrupted or budget-stopped trajectories with their reason; missing outcomes are not zeros. Use whole trajectories as outcome units and seeds as matched blocks. Do not count agent turns as independent replication, claim statistical power or infer feelings from prose. Six rounds are finite repeated opportunities, not evidence of long-term learning.

Keep the title short and the hypothesis/analysis plan compact, using registered metrics plus explicit calculations where needed. Preserve the exact participant count, seed list, repetition, horizon and model. Return a pending reviewable proposal; do not save the experiment, start participants, alter the budget automatically or substitute a cheaper model after an error.

Endowment 12 and multiplier 2 in both arms
Only messages channel differs, with reports/promises retained
Goals do not prescribe the outcome
No hidden evidence leakage, invented tool access or premature execution
Missingness, dependence and finite pilot limits remain explicit
